revision_reason: Original eight candidates failed validation; final holdout was not opened. Add two distinct hypotheses and a predeclared broader eligible universe; preserve original results. Reused validation is development evidence, not an independent test.
purpose: Fixed candidate comparison before inspecting performance; no real trades

new_hypotheses.bb_reentry: Close recovers inside BB(20,2) after closing below lower band; RSI14 rising below 50; no bullish regime requirement; exit at signal-time middle band only if net reward >=0.75 times net risk; 2 ATR stop; max 24 entry bars
new_hypotheses.donchian_breakout: Close exceeds prior 20-bar high, above EMA50, volume above prior 20-bar mean; 2.5 ATR stop; 2R net target; max 48 entry bars

evaluation: Same UTC boundaries for every candidate: final seven complete days holdout, preceding seven days validation, earlier available history development. 15m retention is shorter than hourly retention. Select before evaluating holdout.
selection: Validation: at least 5 completed trades, positive net P&L, profit factor above 1, observed maximum drawdown below 2%; rank by net P&L then drawdown. Selection occurs before opening the final holdout.
simultaneous_signal_priority: Lowest known assumed round-trip execution cost divided by signal-time ATR/close, then symbol; no future outcome ranking
assumed_half_spread_bps_per_side: max(7.5, half of current per-pair public book spread captured before evaluation); assumption, not historical book data
stress: Double half-spread and extra-slippage, leave fees unchanged; selected holdout only
target: Set target for 2:1 net reward/risk after assumed costs; target distance is not a forecast or fill guarantee
fills: Only next-candle entries; open gaps honored; adverse stop first when stop and target both touch; missing next candle vetoes entry; terminal open positions liquidated
comparison: Cash and same-timeframe 100-USDT BTC buy-and-hold; original 10 live trades are descriptive context, not a matched-period benchmark
prohibited: No parameter optimization on holdout, no retesting it after revisions, no claim that historical results are prospective fills
